correctness.rationale: For exponential age T the complex conditional Gaussian moment is (2n-1)!! (4Delta)^n exp(2in theta0) I_T^n. Ordered times in I_T^n and Brownian independent increments yield n!/product_{j=1}^n(r+4gamma j^2); the independent stationary generator recursion (r+4gamma k^2)F_{n,k}=4n(2n-1)Delta F_{n-1,k+1} confirms this without using a log. m2=4Delta exp(2i theta0)/(r+4gamma), m4=96Delta^2 exp(4i theta0)/((r+4gamma)(r+16gamma)); Q decreases 6 to 3/2, giving the inverse gamma/r=(6-Q)/(16Q-24), S=4barD/r and strict A/S<(4Q-6)/(3Q). Boundary gamma=0 is included, infinite gamma excluded; isotropy and common-rate scaling are true degeneracies. Independent rational diagnostic compared the generator product for eight even orders.
